data.body: **[P2] Validate the distributable layer runtime before publishing.** This build skips tests, and the subsequent check only validates ZIP entry names. Existing tests obtain OTel dependencies from their test classpath, so they do not prove that the advertised single-JAR layer works through both application `ServiceLoader` discovery and the agent extension classloader. Add a pre-publication smoke test using the built ZIP, documented function dependencies and Java agent, and both required environment variables, then assert that plugin spans are produced.
